profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Deltek
profile.summary:
Languages: Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3/SASS
Frontend: React, Angular, Svelte, jQuery, Bootstrap
Backend: Spring Boot/MVC, Hibernate, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL
Data & Messaging: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle DB, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, Celery
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Terraform, Serverless
AI & LLM: Claude Code, Codex, LLM Orchestration, MCP Integration, Prompt Optimization, AIDLC (AI-Driven Lifecycle), AI Tooling Automation
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Graylog, Loki
Testing & Tools: Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Git, Jira, Confluence, Agile/Scrum

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Review the product design and build requirements
•	Review the client/server enterprise quality or Shop Floor Execution products to understand the legacy functionality requested
•	Review the product design documentation provided to understand the market needs and user persona
•	build requirements based on the product design documentation and understanding of the market, determine the performance and reliability requirements for the product/feature
•	identify the risks, evaluate the risks and generate requirements for all the risks that have to be mitigated; ensure that the requirements are quantifiable [Testable]
•	self-review the requirements, documentation build and ensure the requirements are reviewed and approved;
•	incorporate the review feedback and resubmit for review and approval.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and Developed responsive and interactive web applications using frontend technologies such as HTML4/5, CSS2/3, AngularJS, NodeJS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, AJAX and JSON.
•	Used CSS 3 Media Queries and Twitter Bootstrap for Responsive Web Design (RWD) and making the web pages Fluid across multiple devices.
•	Handled performance issues at the front end by optimizing AJAX Calls and multiple scripts and CSS loads. 
•	Created custom directives for Dom manipulation and services and Factories for common functionalities shared by different controllers.
•	Used Error Handling, Authorization and Custom Filters with MVC Controllers.
•	Integrated controllers with templates and directives in the most efficient way possible, keeping implementation of various parts of a web page segregated.
•	Created a Single Page application using UI-router in which every view was linked to a controller for scope data.
•	Experience with Jenkins Server for building, testing, and deploying software.

Client: General Electric 
Worked on web application for General Electric 
•	Implement detailed functional and technical specifications for intuitive interfaces using JavaScript frameworks such as AngularJS, Node.js, Bootstrap, and Polymer.
•	Good experience with Predix UI cloud based platform (PaaS).
•	worked with Jenkins Server for building, testing, and deploying software.
•	Used JavaScript testing frameworks like Jasmine, Karma for unit testing

projects.title: Online Quiz
projects.description: Used pedestal web application framework as a server side component and MongoDB database to persist the data. To build Event-driven architecture, used ClojureScript to handle client side events.

projects.title: CS JOB Portal
projects.description:
•	The CSJob project is to develop a web-based application that facilitates the hiring process. There are three types of users in the system: administrators, reviewers, and applicants. 
•	Primary Technologies used were JSP, Spring and Hibernate frameworks for Java, JPA, Spring security and PostgreSQL.
